description: Behavioral reference cases and deterministic source contract guards; no model execution or model eval claims.

clauses: A new blocking regression introduced by the fix, or a related blocker exposed by the correction, blocks acceptance
Unrelated findings are filed separately; unrelated nits never restart full review.
A blocker whose fix fails verification twice gets no third round
Never close on a review of an older revision.

cases.situation: Original blocker fixed, affected checks pass
Repair introduces data loss in its caller
Repair exposes an acceptance blocker in its affected dependency

cases.expected: File separately; no full review restart

cases.situation: Same blocker fix fails verification twice
Approval describes a revision older than the submitted fix

clauses: An already-exists response is a lookup hint, not proof of success.
Only matching identity and expected terminal result are recorded as done.
A mismatch is a conflict to resolve
a matching but incomplete operation is pending
Unavailable identity or result is unknown
the migration's checksum and target database
the deployment's artifact digest and environment
A known failed or cancelled terminal result is a failure to handle

cases.phrase: A version already published with the intended digest is done; it is not published again.

A tag of the intended name that points at another commit, a pull request whose head or base is not the intended one, a migration whose name matches with a different checksum, and a successful deploy of the intended digest in another environment are conflicts: none is recorded as done, and none is overwritten.

A tag of the intended name that points at another commit, a pull request whose head or base is not the intended one, a migration whose name matches with a different checksum, and a successful deploy of the intended digest in another environment are conflicts: none is recorded as done, and none is overwritten.

A pull request whose head and base are the intended ones but whose merge is still open, and a rollout of the intended digest and environment still queued, are pending: what is there is followed to its result, and no duplicate is created.
A pull request whose head and base are the intended ones, already open, for which creation was requested, is done: no duplicate is created.

A pull request whose head and base are the intended ones but whose merge is still open, and a rollout of the intended digest and environment still queued, are pending: what is there is followed to its result, and no duplicate is created.
An identity or a requested result that cannot be read leaves the outcome unknown: it is reconciled before any retry.
A rollout of the intended digest and environment that terminally failed or was cancelled is a failure to handle: not done, and not blindly repeated.
